question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Vigorous
solution:
The correct answer is Delicate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word '**vigorous**' is '**strong, healthy, and full of energy**'.
 
• Let's consider each option-
 
 
• Extreme- Reaching a high or the highest degree; very great.
 
• Delicate- **Very fine in texture or structure**; of intricate workmanship or quality. 
 
• Energetic- Showing or involving great activity or vitality.
 
• Hard- Solid, firm, and rigid; not easily broken, bent, or pierced.
 
 
 
• Hence the most appropriate antonym of the word 'vigorous' is 'delicate'.
 
• Thus option 2 is the correct answer.
